spec: 03 §4: `is_completed = true` requires the fields its tracking mode needs (FR-2.3). Reps for `weight_reps` and `reps_only`, the time for `duration`, the distance for `distance_duration`. Weight is never required: a blank weight is a bodyweight set or a load not recorded, and both are real sets. A zero is a value and only an absent field is missing (INV-03). Task 004 stage 5c wrote the rule on the phone; stage 8 moved it into the core so the API enforces the same one.
expectation_shape: `expected` is the `set_logs` column the set is missing — `reps`, `duration_s` or `distance_m` — or null when it holds what its mode needs. The cases cover all four modes empty and filled, so adding a fifth mode without deciding what it requires fails here.

cases.name: weight × reps with nothing typed is missing its reps
weight × reps with reps and no weight is complete: blank is bodyweight or not recorded
zero reps is a value, not a blank
a time does not stand in for reps
reps only with nothing typed is missing its reps
reps only with reps is complete
a hold with nothing typed is missing its time
a hold with reps and no time is still missing its time
a hold with a time is complete
a carry with nothing typed is missing its distance
a carry with a time and no distance is missing its distance
a carry with a distance is complete, 100 ft as stored
